title: Types of Government
text: Governments can be broadly classified by how power is acquired and exercised. Democracies allow citizens to elect representatives or participate directly in decision-making. Monarchies vest authority in a hereditary ruler, which may be constitutional (limited by law) or absolute. Authoritarian systems concentrate power in a single leader or party with limited public accountability. Federal systems divide power between a central government and regional governments, while unitary systems centralize authority.
